measurement: rule-based intrinsic heights and conservative text allowance; no pixel font measurement

semantic_projection.mode: source IR selects glyph terminals; geometric network selects route

physical_routing.objective: short legal orthogonal routes with few bends
physical_routing.caption_policy: canonical source route selects caption identity; editable path anchors follow displayed geometry
physical_routing.border_policy: painted shaft and frame half-widths plus 2px air gap; corner gates and shared forks adapt within source scope
physical_routing.gate_policy: source-recorded straight ancestor exits follow their endpoint; gate side and hierarchy stay fixed
